general meeting of the body corporate is held.
(3) The ideologist of the Lions Hospital Trust Mr. Anil
Nanayakkara,  and  Mr.  K.G.  Wijayasiri,  the  pioneer  of  the
Lions  Hospital  shall  be  the  lifetime  members  of  the  Trust
while nine other members from the ex-officio be appointed
via the annual general meeting whom shall serve for a period
of three years.
(4) There  shall  be  a  Board  of  Management  comprising
six members who shall be in charge for administration and
the  operation  of  the  Hospital  and  be  made  under  the
supervision of the board of Trustees.
